contentMap.productCategory: AI image generation and AI video generation
contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals, creators, and enterprise users looking for high-quality AI-generated visuals and videos

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description:
Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs.
The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature:-
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description:
Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together.
Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

referenceMap.heroPattern: Large split hero with brand/logo anchor, prominent H1, short supporting paragraph, and compact benefit bullets. Primary CTA is visually dominant; secondary action is absent or de-emphasized. Hero sits on a high-contrast full-width band with strong top-to-bottom hierarchy.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Single-column narrative flow below the hero, moving from trust/bullets into focused product feature blocks. Sections are stacked vertically with clear separation, minimal lateral complexity, and repeated CTA-led feature groupings.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Simple content cards or feature rows rather than decorative cards. Use light surfaces, modest rounding, subtle borders or shadows, and dense but readable feature lists. Visual emphasis comes from typography and spacing, not ornamentation.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: One primary CTA in the hero, then section-level action buttons near feature descriptions. CTA hierarchy is straightforward: filled primary button for conversion, secondary actions only if needed and visually quieter. Repetition is sparse and intent-driven.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing module detected. Conversion is lead-generation oriented rather than self-serve purchase oriented.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not defined in the provided reference content. Treat as a minimal informational footer if needed, with low visual priority.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Hero is text-forward with optional brand mark/logo; product sections are primarily copy-led with feature lists. If media is used, it should be secondary and aligned to the content block rather than full-bleed storytelling. No evidence of heavy image grids.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Each product section uses a label, headline, descriptive paragraph, then a feature list with short title-plus-description items. Structure supports progressive disclosure: broad summary first, then capabilities. Reuse as stacked feature modules with consistent spacing and repeated CTA placement.
referenceMap.formPattern: Lead-generation form appears as a distinct card below the hero, separated from the marketing content. Form treatment is utility-first, with a concise title, multiple fields, and strong visual containment. Best replicated as a compact conversion panel rather than embedded inline.
referenceMap.animationStyle: No visible interaction animation pattern in the reference HTML. If motion is introduced, keep it subtle and functional: light fades, gentle scroll reveals, or minimal hover state transitions.
componentPatterns: Bullet benefit list with check icons
Feature list items with title and description
Section dividers via spacing rather than heavy rules
designNotes: Prioritize conversion hierarchy over visual novelty.
Use strong typography scale: oversized hero headline, medium section headings, compact feature copy.
Keep content blocks narrow enough for readability, especially for long-form technical messaging.
Use repeated structure across products for easy scanning and comparison.
The page favors utility and clarity over decorative marketing elements.
If adapting to a modern system, maintain the dense information architecture but simplify the visual treatment.

personality.buyer: professionals, creators, marketing teams, and enterprise users needing high-quality AI-generated images and videos
personality.emotion: awe, precision, speed, and creative control
personality.reasoning: This product is not a generic SaaS tool; it is a premium generative AI platform for producing polished visual content. The visual language should feel intelligent, experimental, and high-end without becoming overly dark or overly neon. Seedream 4.5 needs a more editorial, precision-led image-making feel, while Seedance 1.5 Pro should shift into cinematic motion with audio-visual energy. The page should alternate between light, clean, product-led sections and deeper cinematic sections to create strong contrast and keep the experience immersive. The overall design must communicate enterprise trust, model sophistication, and creative possibility.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The hero headline is long and needs to stay premium while fitting comfortably in a split layout. 56px maintains impact without overcrowding the composition.

colours.colourReason: A deep ink primary gives the product a premium AI-lab feel, while Techjockey's orange accent preserves brand continuity and makes CTAs feel active and conversion-focused. Light surfaces keep the image-generation section clean and professional, and darker cinematic panels create contrast for the video model section.

layout.heroBackground: dark cinematic gradient with layered abstract visual shell and floating model chips
layout.heroReason: The hero should feel premium and intelligent immediately. A split layout lets the text sell the product clearly while the right side can carry a layered AI visual composition, mock render frames, and floating capability chips.
layout.featureReason: Separate Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro into distinct product sections with strong contrast: a clean editorial grid for image generation, then a darker cinematic panel for video generation. This prevents the page from feeling repetitive and reinforces the different strengths of each model.
layout.darkSectionFor: Seedance 1.5 Pro video generation section, proof/stat bars, and select spotlight cards

personality.imageryDirection: Use a premium layered hero visual: abstract AI interface shells, sample image frames, timeline/video strips, floating chips, and cinematic light streaks. Seedream 4.5 visuals should resemble high-fidelity image outputs and editing panels; Seedance 1.5 Pro visuals should suggest motion, waveform sync, and camera control. Use SVG for logos/icons, PNG for product/UI visuals, and JPEG for any large immersive hero composition or generated imagery showcase.
personality.designPersonality: Premium, visually intelligent, and motion-aware. It should feel like a high-end creative AI workstation: precise typography, layered surfaces, floating capability chips, subtle glow accents, interactive tabs, and strong visual contrast between image and video generation. Clean enough for enterprise trust, expressive enough for creators, and sophisticated enough to imply ByteDance-level model quality.

designIntent.audience: Professionals, creators, and enterprise users looking for high-quality AI-generated visuals and videos
designIntent.primaryUserIntent: Evaluate ByteDance generative models for professional image and video production, then request a demo or quote

brandDirection.tone: Expert, warm, results-focused, and technically credible
brandDirection.visualStyle: High-contrast, text-forward enterprise landing page with a strong hero, stacked narrative sections, simple content cards, and minimal ornamentation

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish immediate value proposition, communicate both models clearly, and drive the primary conversion action.
Reinforce capability breadth and enterprise readiness before deeper product evaluation.
Showcase image generation depth, high-resolution output, editing, composition, and typographic quality.
Explain AI video generation benefits, audio-visual synchronization, lip-sync, and cinematic control.
Provide quote-oriented commercial framing and qualify leads without self-serve checkout pressure.
Add credibility through role-based social proof and reinforce adoption confidence for creative and enterprise buyers.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Text-led hero with dominant headline, short supporting paragraph, compact benefit bullets, and one primary CTA
componentNeeds.notes: Use a strong full-width dark or deep brand-toned background with white text. Keep secondary CTA absent or visually de-emphasized. Since no product UI screenshot is provided, favor centered or slightly split composition with high contrast.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Pill badges with compact enterprise-value labels
componentNeeds.notes: Show trust badges in a horizontal row or wrapped line. Keep this section lightweight and visually separating the hero from the detailed product blocks.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Label + headline + descriptive paragraph + 5-item feature list
componentNeeds.notes: Use a clean single-column narrative block with simple feature cards or feature rows. Emphasize resolution, multimodal editing, typographic rendering, identity preservation, and structural fidelity.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Label + headline + descriptive paragraph + 6-item feature list
componentNeeds.notes: Keep the sequencing parallel to Seedream for consistency. Prioritize audio-visual synchronization, text-to-video, lip-sync, cinematic camera control, and speed.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Two elevated quote-oriented plan cards with checklist inclusions
componentNeeds.notes: Treat pricing as lead generation, not e-commerce. Preserve quote/consultation behavior using 'Get Quote' CTAs. Highlight the starting price only where available and keep the layout compact.
Use role-based quotes with strong readability. One testimonial entry appears truncated; visually treat it as incomplete content or omit if not cleanly usable in the final layout.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a large, high-impact hero with the headline as the dominant element, followed by a short supporting paragraph and 2-4 compact benefit bullets. Place the primary CTA prominently above the fold and keep the hero visually authoritative rather than decorative.
layoutStrategy.features: Stack product sections vertically in a narrative flow. Each section should feel dense but readable, using simple cards or rows, modest borders, and clear typographic hierarchy. Avoid complex grids beyond the feature list itself.
layoutStrategy.proof: Use the trust badge row immediately after the hero and then testimonials later in the page. Keep proof lightweight and enterprise-oriented, focused on capability validation rather than broad marketing claims.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Present pricing as quote-led commercial intent with elevated cards, checklist-style inclusions, and clear CTA hierarchy. Do not create a checkout-style flow.
layoutStrategy.form: No form section is provided. Do not invent one. Use CTAs that direct toward quote/demo inquiry instead.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Use the default Techjockey system with a professional, high-trust visual direction. Prefer Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body. Use a dark authoritative hero with a strong accent color, white feature sections, light grey separation bands, clean 12px-radius cards, and subtle elevation only. The page should feel enterprise-ready, technical, and conversion-focused.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design a high-trust, lead-generation landing page for two ByteDance generative AI products. Start with a strong split or centered hero, one dominant CTA, and compact benefit bullets. Follow with a lightweight trust strip, then two stacked product narrative sections with structured feature lists. Finish with quote-oriented pricing cards and testimonial proof. Keep the system simple, copy-led, and enterprise credible, with minimal motion and no decorative clutter.

figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: default brand system with marketing-forward styling; use Sora for headings and Inter for body; hero should use strong dark brand band with white text, accent CTA, and compact benefit bullets

sections.variantHint: dark hero band with brand anchor, left text stack and right supporting visual placeholder or abstract brand panel; primary CTA filled, no secondary CTA emphasis
sections.notes: Use a split hero because the page is product-led and conversion-oriented. Keep copy dense but readable. Include supporting line and a compact 3-item benefit bullet cluster derived from the hero message. Primary CTA must be visually dominant. Secondary CTA is intentionally absent or de-emphasized per input.

sections.variantHint: award/badge strip on light grey background with centered pills and even spacing
sections.notes: Render as a horizontal trust bar directly under hero. Use the four badges as pill elements with subtle separators. Do not invent customer counts or logos because the input does not provide them. Keep this section low-height and visually separating.

sections.variantHint: label + headline + paragraph + 5-feature grid; card-based feature list with light surfaces and minimal icon treatment
sections.notes: Section should read as a focused product module. Lead with the feature label, then headline, then description. Use a 3-column grid for five features on desktop, with the last card wrapping naturally. Each feature is a simple card or row with title and short description. Include the section CTA 'Request Demo' aligned near the headline or bottom of the block.

sections.variantHint: label + headline + paragraph + 6-feature grid; split into a compact introductory row plus 3-column feature cards
sections.notes: This block should continue the narrative flow with a clear visual break from Seedream. Because there are six features, use a 3-column grid in two rows on desktop. Keep the first feature as a top summary card or intro row if needed, then the remaining capability cards below. No CTA is required here unless space allows, but do not force one.

sections.variantHint: two centered plan cards on light grey background; lead-gen pricing rather than checkout flow
sections.notes: Even though this is a lead-generation page, pricing content is explicitly supplied, so render it as a pricing module. Use two cards side by side. The Seedance plan includes the only explicit price and should visually emphasize 'Starting at $1,000/month/' with the rest of the price structure left minimal if absent. Include plan includes lists and CTA buttons. Keep purchase signals lead-gen oriented and avoid checkout UI.

sections.variantHint: 3-column testimonial cards with star rating row, italic quote, bold author, grey designation line, accent left border
sections.notes: Use only the provided four testimonials. The fourth quote is truncated, so either omit it or treat it as an incomplete draft note if the design system requires a final card placeholder; do not fabricate the missing text. Keep the three complete testimonials as primary content. Use gold stars for all visible cards.

sections.variantHint: text-first hero with compact visual or no visual depending on fit; primary CTA full width and stacked content
sections.notes: Stack hero content vertically. If the visual is retained, place it above text only when it does not compress headline readability. Keep CTA full width. Reduce bullet density to maintain scanability.

sections.variantHint: wrapped badges in a compact stacked row or two-line cluster
sections.notes: Convert the trust bar into a two-row wrapped badge cluster for mobile. Maintain badge styling but reduce horizontal density. No counts or extra proof points should be added.

sections.variantHint: label, headline, description, then single-column feature cards
sections.notes: Use a single-column stack of feature cards. Preserve the CTA if space permits, but prioritize readability over density. The feature cards should be compact and consistent, with short title and description pairs.

sections.variantHint: label, headline, description, then single-column feature cards with progressive disclosure
sections.notes: Collapse the 6-feature list into a single-column flow. Keep the introductory capability statement visible and use compact cards below. No forced CTA. Keep the section rhythm clear and consistent with the Seedream module.

sections.variantHint: two pricing cards stacked vertically with prominent CTA buttons and simplified include lists
sections.notes: Stack pricing cards vertically. Keep the explicit price highly visible on the Seedance card. Full-width CTA buttons are required. Reduce ornamental spacing and keep list items short for small screens.

sections.variantHint: single-column testimonial cards; optionally horizontally scrollable only if needed for density
sections.notes: Use a single-column stack for mobile. Preserve the star row, italic quote, author, and designation hierarchy. Do not add any missing testimonial text. Keep the section visually lightweight to avoid making the page too long.

figmaExecutionNotes: Use a dark, high-contrast hero band aligned with Techjockey's marketing-first default rather than a white hero.
Keep all product sections copy-led with simple card or row patterns; avoid decorative illustration grids.
Maintain clear vertical rhythm and strong section separation using background shifts and spacing rather than heavy borders.
Do not invent a form or news section because the input does not support them.
Treat the fourth testimonial as incomplete and do not fabricate missing copy.
Use Sora for headings and Inter for body text across the page.
Primary CTAs should be filled and prominent; keep secondary CTA absent unless explicitly required by content.
